svg.text: SatQuery AI — System Architecture & End-to-End Workflow
An Interactive Vision-Language Assistant for Multimodal Remote Sensing Image Analysis Through Text Queries

g.text: Forecast API · point in the AOI
Explain the reason › ask the user to refine
no guessed answer, no fake fallback
VLM · optical · SAR · change · fusion · weather
prepares only what the chosen workflow needs
Clip & mask to the AOI shape
each engine runs only for the workflows marked on it (A–E)

svg.text: SatQuery AI converts natural-language queries into evidence-grounded remote-sensing insights through intelligent data selection, analysis and visualization.
